name: Road Accident Analytics Platform
description: A full-stack web application developed for the digitization, management, and analysis of road traffic accident data. The platform centralizes records, streamlines data access, generates reports, and provides visualization tools to support decision-making processes.
highlights: Frontend built with React and TypeScript for a modern and scalable user interface
Backend developed with NestJS and TypeScript using a modular architecture and REST APIs
MySQL database design and management for structured data storage
Administrative dashboard for record and report management
Interactive charts and statistical data visualization

name: Minimum Cost Calculator
description: A full-stack web application designed to calculate and optimize minimum costs through an intuitive interface and real-time processing. The project combines a React frontend with a FastAPI backend built in Python.
highlights: Frontend developed with React and TypeScript
Backend implemented with FastAPI and Python for high-performance API development
Responsive design for desktop and mobile devices
